name: Band Pallof Press
steps: Stand sideways to a chest-height band anchor with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping the band against your sternum until it holds firm tension.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly with your knees slightly soft.
Press your hands straight out in front of your chest until your arms extend fully while resisting the sideways pull.
Draw your hands slowly back to your chest, then turn around and switch sides after completing one side.
tips: Keep your hands centered directly in line with your breastbone rather than letting them drift toward the anchor.
Maintain tall, square shoulders without leaning away from the pull.
